lines.text: It was nice talking to you. I need to go now or I will miss my bus.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Of course. Are we still meeting at the park on Saturday morning?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Yes. Can we meet at the gate near the lake at ten?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: The lake gate at ten works for me. Do you still have my blue book?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Yes, I will bring it on Saturday. Thanks for letting me keep it this week.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: You are welcome. I hope you have time to finish the last story.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: I think I can finish it tonight. All right, see you on Saturday.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: See you then. Have a good evening and good luck with the bus!
lines.speaker: Eli
